newsitem.title: FRANCE: France denies has Aerospatiale bid for Thomson-CSF.
newsitem.headline: France denies has Aerospatiale bid for Thomson-CSF.

text.p: The French defence and finance ministries said on Monday there was no basis for newspaper reports that aircraft makers Aerospatiale and Dassault Aviation were candidates in the privatisation of electronics firm Thomson-CSF.

"Any reports of the candidature in the Thomson-CSF privatisation by Dassault Aviation and Aerospatiale, as well as any other potential candidate, should be considered as being without foundation," a defence ministry spokesman told Reuters.

That position was shared by the finance ministry and was based on the view that the privatisation procedure for Thomson-CSF will only be decided in January and that any talk of a bid before then was premature, he added.
Aerospatiale and Dassault would also have to inform the government, which is their shareholder. "The government has no knowledge of such a bid from these companies," he said.
